text:
Alex P: Heads up — ACME Cloud procurement paused launch due to PO format + signatory mismatch. They need our PO with vendor alias and a treasury signatory.
Rina K: Ugh. Which fields are failing on their side?
Alex P: Their portal rejects if `vendor_alias` != registered name. They also require `signer_role` = 'Treasurer' on PO. We only auto-fill 'Authorized Rep'.
Tom H: Can we generate a one-off PO export with `vendor_alias` populated? That should be quick in the marketplace flow.
Leah S: Legal flagged clause 7.2 in our master SOW — vendor is asking for an indemnity tweak tied to PO acceptance. They want explicit acceptance to mean indemnity applies.
Priya M: @Leah S can you paste the exact redline? If it's simple we can accept for marketplace deals with a limited waiver.
Leah S: Paste below: ```We propose replacing 'Customer' with 'Customer and its Affiliates' in §7.2. Also add: 'Acceptance of Purchase Order constitutes agreement to the terms herein.'```
Alex P: The acceptance sentence is the sticking point — it could create automatic legal binding on PO upload which our finance team dislikes.
Rina K: MarketplaceBot just posted an error from ACME portal: "PO schema validation failed: vendor_alias mismatch; signer_role not allowed." (see attached link) :warning:
Tom H: For the signer_role we can map 'Treasurer' to 'Authorized Rep' during export but ACME insists on exact string. I can add an override flag in the PO API but need approvals.
Priya M: Finance will require a signed note from ACME that 'Treasurer' equals their procurement delegate. Can Partnerships get confirmation from their procurement contact?
Alex P: I pinged Marta (ACME procurement) — waiting. Estimated hold is 48-72 hours if we don't do a one-off.
Leah S: From Legal: short-term workaround — we can add a supplemental acceptance doc routed after PO upload that clarifies acceptance does not modify indemnity beyond SOW. But that's an extra step for customer.
Rina K: Is there a precedence? Did we do supplemental acceptance with NovaEdge last quarter?
Alex P: Yes, but NovaEdge accepted the doc via DocuSign. This customer wants zero friction.
Tom H: Proposal: create temporary PO export with `vendor_alias` = registered name and `signer_role` = 'Treasurer' plus a hidden metadata tag `internal_override:true`. Finance to approve only for this partner.
Priya M: I can fast-track finance approval if Legal signs off on a scoped waiver: no permanent policy change, one-time export, flag in ledger.
Leah S: I can provide that waiver language now. I'll drop it in #legal-review and tag you.
MarketplaceBot: Deploy check: marketplace-po-export service currently at v2.14.3, no incidents.
Alex P: OK — action items: Tom to prepare export flag PR, Leah to draft waiver, Priya to get finance pre-approval, Rina to keep ACME procurement updated. I will update thread when Marta replies. :thumbsup:
Rina K: Noted. pinging Marta again now.
Tom H: PR opened: `feat: po-export override for partner_alias` — only behind enterprise feature flag. Link: https://git.redwood/po-export/pull/482
Leah S: Waiver posted in #legal-review: "One-time PO export override for ACME Cloud. No policy change; recorded in contract ledger. Legal counsel: Leah S."
Priya M: Finance verbally approved contingent on ledger flag. Sending formal note in 1h.
Alex P: Marta responded — will accept DocuSign supplemental if we can do same-day DocuSign. She confirms Treasurer==Procurement Director.
Rina K: Great. Closing for now — moving to implementation. Will reopen if ACME portal errors persist. :white_check_mark:
